summary: Fix makes the n_jobs==1 path derive a per-run seed via random_state.randint and a fresh check_random_state, mirroring the parallel path so sequential and parallel runs consume randomness identically and yield the same inertia. Correct, minimal, and resolves the reported discrepancy.

issues.description: `zip(range(n_init), seeds)` is redundant; `enumerate(seeds)` is cleaner. Also the loop variable `it` is unused in the body, same as before the change.
